referenceCanvas.coordinateRule: Use normalized coordinates so the complete composition scales as one unit. Do not independently stretch the frame, map, sockets, or right ledger.

primaryAssetNames.nativeIconSources: Matching files use the same names with -native instead of -128 in the primary Guided Hunt asset folder.
primaryAssetNames.detourIcon: Use the project's unique-item indicator when available. The mockup currently uses clue-cache-128.png only as a temporary route marker.

mapArea.rule: All route lines and map markers use this region as their coordinate space. Preserve the existing map artwork inside it.

visualStates.past: Dimmed but readable and marked complete.
visualStates.current: Gold outline and restrained glow; scale slightly above adjacent nodes.
visualStates.future: Strongly dimmed and desaturated; hide its text label until reached.

route.interaction: Selecting either a map marker or its bottom socket opens that stage in the right ledger. Advancing updates the route line, marker state, socket state, and recent hunt log.

clueChoices.rule: Every clue presents skill-based read choices. A choice contributes its Magic Find/reward consequences and immediately records the listed mastery gain.
clueChoices.masteryDisplay: Mastery gained must stack in Current Promise as one line per completed clue. Never replace an earlier clue's mastery line with the newest selection.
clueChoices.selectionBehavior: Changing a clue choice updates only that clue's mastery entry and recalculates the current promise.

currentPromise.rule: This is a live cumulative summary, not merely the reward for the selected stage. It updates after each clue, special route, or generated encounter.

uniqueDetour.visibility: Render a detour only when that generated detour offers a Unique item. Do not show detours for magic, rare, generic, or ordinary extra items.

choices.label: Stay on trail
choices.resultPreview: Keep the current run with no detour risk

takeResolution.success: Add the Unique item to Current Promise, close the branch, and resume the hunt at the existing stage.
takeResolution.failure: Forfeit the entire Guided Hunt, the target, and all currently promised run loot, then return to the Hunter Camp flow.
takeResolution.masteryOnFailure: Previously earned clue mastery is career learning and should remain earned unless the game's existing mastery rules explicitly defer it until hunt completion.

uniqueDetour.copyRequirement: The 50% whole-run forfeiture must be visible before confirmation; do not hide it in a tooltip.

companionEncounter.visibility: Only render when the hunt generator has produced a companion encounter.
companionEncounter.behavior: Selecting the node opens a companion encounter state in the right ledger. Completing the hunt adds the companion to the menagerie.
companionEncounter.currentPromise: When generated, add a Companion row with Encounter found.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Keep the full 3:2 framed composition and overlay all content using percentages.
responsiveBehavior.smallScreens: Scale the complete shell uniformly first. If the game uses a dedicated phone layout, preserve the same information hierarchy: route/map, current stage decision, Current Promise, then socket history.
responsiveBehavior.minimumRequirement: No icon, label, choice, or reward row may overlap ornamental frame pixels or leave its painted usable region.

acceptanceChecks: The map artwork and fake-writing detail remain visible behind the route.
All eight normal route nodes follow the correct order.
The seven bottom sockets align with their painted openings and their icons remain inside the squares.
Clue mastery entries accumulate instead of replacing one another.
A non-Unique detour is never rendered.
Taking a Unique detour clearly exposes and applies the 50% whole-run forfeiture roll.
Generated companions appear both on the map and in Current Promise.
Quit and Auto Resolve use existing game confirmation and resolution rules rather than mockup-only behavior.
